lines: Himanshu Kantilal Sanghavi HUF, an Investor Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 25,200 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹3.41 crore, if all offered shares are sold; the money is in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Retained shares of about ₹7.95 crore at offer price have been unlocked since 9 Sep 2026, so more money is possible later.
Shares were unlocked 67 days ago, so the event is not recent; actual proceeds may be slightly lower due to employee discounts.
